ranking_metric: PyPI Stats last_month downloads excluding known mirrors
selection: mutagen (10,748,990) is the most-downloaded candidate whose own Python source parses MPEG Layer III frame headers from a documented byte or file-object API. av, soundfile, pydub and librosa rank higher but hand frame parsing to native FFmpeg or libsndfile/libmpg123, or to an external ffmpeg process.
shared_family: Same Mutagen package, release 1.48.1 and mutagen/mp3 module as the mp3_id3v2/python mutagen entry. This cell checks MPEGInfo on untagged streams; it is not an independent parser family.
uncertainty: One verified path; no padding. The name search is a substring filter over the PyPI Simple index (serial 43764887) captured 2026-11-17; the 'mp3' and 'mpeg' hit lists were not triaged one by one, and download numbers were fetched only for 13 named candidates, so a less obvious frame parser could be missed. Native wrappers (av, soundfile, audioread, pygame, pymediainfo, miniaudio) are unresolved, not rejected: their parsers are real but outside Python source coverage. tinytag, eyed3, hachoir and pymp3 are unresolved pure-Python leads. Mutagen reads headers and checks frame syncs but does not decode audio; for CBR streams without Xing/Info/VBRI its duration is stream bytes divided by the first header's bitrate. Two untagged CBR controls do not establish VBR, free-format, Layer I/II, or MPEG-2.5 support.
